scheduled_files.link_timers.fsm:
(?fsm:link_timers

  (+system
    (clock clk)
    (areset rst_n)
  )

  (+interface
    (input start)
    (input ack)
    (output done)
  )

  (+size
    (start 1)
    (ack 1)
    (done 1)
    (can_accept 1)
    (last_error 1)
    (pending_wd 11)
  )

  (pending_idle_0
    (= (can_accept 1))
    (<= (pending_wd (- 1250 1)))
    (<start
      (-> pending_await_1)
    )
  )

  (pending_await_1
    (<ack
      (-> pending_done_2)
    )
    (?pending_wd
      (=0 (-> pending_timeout))
      (>0 (-- pending_wd))
    )
  )

  (pending_done_2
    (<1 (done> 1))
    (-> pending_idle_0)
  )

  (pending_timeout
    (<1 (done> 1))
    (<- (last_error 1))
    (-> pending_idle_0)
  )

)
